items.text: Rams WR Puka Nacua did not practice for the second straight day due to hip injury. McVay noted he is not making great progress and status for Week 3 vs DEN remains uncertain, though not long-term.
items.why: Second consecutive DNP; McVay cautious on progress.
items.implication: High risk of missing Week 3 SNF; Adams continues elevated role.

items.text: Texans WR Nico Collins did not practice for the second straight day due to hamstring injury.
items.why: Consecutive DNPs raise OUT risk for Week 3.
items.implication: Schultz and others elevated if out @ IND.

items.text: Ravens WR Zay Flowers (hamstring) no practice second straight day; looking like without him for second consecutive game vs DAL in Brazil. Originated Aug 20 joint practice, aggravated Week 1 after 5-150-1 half.
items.why: No full practice since aggravation; Brazil travel factor.
items.opportunity: Secondary WR/TE targets in Ravens offense

items.text: Giants QB Jaxson Dart officially placed on IR after expected knee surgery (meniscus main issue, MCL/PCL damage, ACL intact); full recovery but ends 2026 season. Possible playoff door left open.
items.implication: Giants QB carousel; Winston or others stream; Nabers impacted long-term.

items.text: After good MRI results on stinger, Saquon Barkley is on the practice field (suited up); expects to play Monday vs Bears. Limited participation possible.
items.why: Good MRI, on field, self-expects play.
items.implication: Start with confidence; reverse handcuff stashes if clear.

items.text: Jonathon Brooks expected on IR (only 5 games in 3 seasons); pushes Chuba Hubbard firmly into lead role, AJ Dillon primary backup (Etienne also IR).
items.implication: Hubbard every-week starter upgrade; Dillon stash.

items.text: TNF spots: Has Marshawn Lloyd blown chance/ceded backfield to Kaleb Johnson? Penix healthy enough to revive Drake London and Kyle Pitts? Reed absence lead to more 2-TE? Packers OL hold for Watson/Golden?
items.implication: Monitor snaps for London/Pitts boom; Watson upside; Lloyd downgrade risk.

items.text: Drake London has played 12 career games with Michael Penix: avg over 20 PPR pts, 35% target share, 97 rec yds/game. (Also Henderson 65% snaps post-Stevenson fumble; still ranks Stevenson ahead W3).
items.why: Historical production with Penix; snap data on NE backfield.
items.implication: London smash with Penix healthy TNF; NE RB committee tighter.
items.opportunity: London targets with Penix; Henderson volume

items.text: Dallas Goedert will miss a few weeks with MCL sprain (enough to drop for plug-and-play); Eagles signed Zach Ertz to practice squad. Avoid IR for now.
items.why: Sources confirm few weeks; Ertz added.
items.implication: Droppable in shallows; Wicks/Mundt short-term TE options.

items.text: Loves Derrick Henry vs DAL (Brazil): highest RB rush yards prop (88.5); Dallas 30th rush D allowing 173.5 ypg. Feed him.
items.why: Elite matchup vs poor run D; high prop.
items.implication: Strong RB1 start in Brazil game.

items.text: Loves Chase Brown @ PIT: 20+ touches and 15% target share both games; RB7 utilization (86); PIT allows 5th-most rush yds to RBs.
Loves Chris Olave vs LV (double-digit tgts, 14.8 aDOT, 53% air yards; LV allows league-high 18.7 ypr to WRs) and Dalton Schultz @ IND (28% tgt share last week sans Collins; IND 4th-most yds to TEs).
items.why: Volume + matchup edges; Schultz boosted by Collins absence.
items.implication: Start both; Schultz TE1 streamer if Collins out.

items.text: Hates Travis Etienne vs LV (only 49% RB touches, 38% 3rd-down snaps even with Kamara; role not there) and Rhamondre Stevenson @ JAX (31% snaps/5 touches post-fumble; JAX stout vs RBs 55 yds/3.2 ypc).
items.why: Limited roles + tough matchups; Henderson took over post-fumble (65% snaps).
items.conflict: Usage favors sit over recent production hope
